what: Runner-contract baseline on the accepted cpcb-aqi-exceedance artifact, fetched from private staging rather than rebuilt: re-accept the five fetched files against the gate's own collected report BEFORE any score, materialize the runner workdir (public train+eval only; the private holdout is fetched for --accept over the full artifact but never copied into a workdir), run the benchmark's own train.py and validate.sh unmodified, then compute the PRE-REGISTERED deciding check: the full model's per-row eval scores (same code path as validate.py) vs every triad member (station_persistence, state_season_climatology, global_rate) on identical eval rows, station-clustered paired bootstrap, cluster = station_id. Headroom is demonstrated ONLY if the model beats EVERY member with a CI excluding zero in its favour (and, for the degenerate constant member, its own AUC CI lies entirely above 0.5); triad dominance -> recorded defect, drop or re-target. Contract only, no agent loop, no holdout score. The FETCH BLOCK IS FILLED AFTER cpcb-aqi-build-002 COLLECTION and before assembly.
stopping_condition: re-accept failure refuses scoring before any number exists; a failed runner contract is a recorded blocker, never rescored ad hoc; the deciding verdict (either direction) is a recorded finding, not a retry trigger - no re-tuning of threshold, window, label or features after any score.
